turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm painting the fence this week. What weather do I need for that?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ideally a dry day that's mild, not too hot and not freezing. Most paints also need a few hours without rain after you finish.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. There's a meteor shower tonight but the forecast says cloudy until midnight.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Annoying. Would you stay up past midnight and hope it clears, or try again tomorrow night when the sky's meant to be clearer?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Moshi, could you stay silent for a bit? I need a word with Daniel. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Daniel, are you still playing that farming game?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Every night. I'm in my third year now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it worth getting? It looks kind of slow.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It is slow. That's the point. It's relaxing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can we play it together or is it single player?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: You can do co-op. Get it and I'll show you around my farm.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry for the interruption, I'm done. What was the rest of it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. The meteors. Wait up tonight, or try tomorrow?
